WITH SchoolSATCounts AS (
  SELECT cds, SUM(COALESCE(NumTstTakr, 0)) AS TotalTakers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
FilteredSchools AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.GSserved
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN SchoolSATCounts sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Operating'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
    AND (sat.TotalTakers IS NULL OR sat.TotalTakers = 0)
),
NormalizedGrades AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    School,
    GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'Pre%' THEN 0
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'PK%' THEN 0
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'K%' THEN 1
      ELSE CAST(substr(GSserved, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) + 1
    END AS StartGrade
  FROM FilteredSchools
)
SELECT School, GSserved
FROM NormalizedGrades
WHERE StartGrade = (SELECT MIN(StartGrade) FROM NormalizedGrades)
ORDER BY School ASC
;

  SELECT CDSCode, School, MailStreet, MailCity, MailZip, MailState
  FROM schools
  WHERE DOC = 'California State Board of Education'
    AND School IS NOT NULL
    AND MailStreet IS NOT NULL
    AND MailCity IS NOT NULL
    AND MailState IS NOT NULL
    AND MailZip IS NOT NULL
),
qualified_scores AS (
  SELECT cds, AvgScrRead
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
    AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
    AND cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM cde_schools)
),

  SELECT MAX(AvgScrRead) AS max_read
  FROM qualified_scores
)

FROM cde_schools s
JOIN qualified_scores qs ON s.CDSCode = qs.cds

  WHERE NCESDist = '0632640' AND StatusType = 'Open' AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
),
first_grade AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(
      CASE
        WHEN INSTR(GSserved, ',') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, ',') - 1)
        WHEN INSTR(GSserved, '-') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, '-') - 1)

),

  SELECT CASE
    WHEN grade_str = 'P' THEN 0
    WHEN grade_str GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(grade_str AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS grade_level
  FROM first_grade
  WHERE grade_str IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT MIN(grade_level) AS lowest_grade_level
FROM normalized_grades;

WITH StateSpecialSchools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CDSCode, "School Name"
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-15'
      AND "School Type" = 'State Special'
      AND "School Name" IS NOT NULL
      AND "School Name" != ''
),
EarliestGradeNum AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, "School Name" AS School, 
      CASE 
        WHEN "Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0
        WHEN "Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1
        ELSE CAST("Low Grade" AS INTEGER)
      END AS EarliestGradeNum,
      "Enrollment (K-12)"
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-15'
      AND CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM StateSpecialSchools)
),
SATCounts AS (
    SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS NumTstTakr
    FROM satscores
    WHERE rtype = 'S' AND cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM StateSpecialSchools)
    GROUP BY cds
),
SchoolData AS (
    SELECT eg.CDSCode, eg.School, eg.EarliestGradeNum, eg."Enrollment (K-12)", COALESCE(sc.NumTstTakr, 0) AS SATTestTakers
    FROM EarliestGradeNum eg
    LEFT JOIN SATCounts sc ON eg.CDSCode = sc.cds
)
SELECT School, 
    CASE 
      WHEN EarliestGradeNum = 0 THEN 'P'
      WHEN EarliestGradeNum = 1 THEN 'K'
      ELSE CAST(EarliestGradeNum AS TEXT)
    END AS EarliestGrade,
    "Enrollment (K-12)" AS K12Enrollment,
    SATTestTakers
FROM SchoolData
ORDER BY EarliestGradeNum DESC, "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC, School
LIMIT 1;

WITH StateSpecialSchools AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    School
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA' AND FundingType = 'State Special'
),
K12Enrollments AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    MAX("Enrollment (K-12)") AS K12Enrollment,
    MIN(CASE
      WHEN "Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0
      WHEN "Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1
      WHEN CAST("Low Grade" AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 12 THEN CAST("Low Grade" AS INTEGER) + 1
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS EarliestGradeCode
  FROM frpm
  WHERE CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM StateSpecialSchools)
    AND "Academic Year" = '2014-15'
  GROUP BY CDSCode
),
SATCounts AS (
  SELECT
    cds AS CDSCode,
    SUM(NumTstTakr) AS SATTestTakers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
StateSpecialWithData AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    k.EarliestGradeCode,
    k.K12Enrollment,
    COALESCE(sc.SATTestTakers, 0) AS SATTestTakers
  FROM StateSpecialSchools s
  JOIN K12Enrollments k ON s.CDSCode = k.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN SATCounts sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
),
Ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY EarliestGradeCode DESC, K12Enrollment DESC, School ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM StateSpecialWithData
)
SELECT
  School AS school_name,
  EarliestGradeCode AS earliest_grade_level_covered,
  K12Enrollment AS k12_enrollment,
  SATTestTakers AS sat_test_takers
FROM Ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH monthly_openings AS (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', OpenDate) AS year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS schools_opened
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'San Diego' AND OpenDate >= '1980-01-01' AND OpenDate < '1981-01-01'
  GROUP BY year_month
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT '1980-01' AS year_month UNION ALL SELECT '1980-02' UNION ALL SELECT '1980-03' UNION ALL SELECT '1980-04' UNION ALL 
  SELECT '1980-05' UNION ALL SELECT '1980-06' UNION ALL SELECT '1980-07' UNION ALL SELECT '1980-08' UNION ALL 
  SELECT '1980-09' UNION ALL SELECT '1980-10' UNION ALL SELECT '1980-11' UNION ALL SELECT '1980-12'
),
monthly_counts_filled AS (
  SELECT am.year_month, COALESCE(mo.schools_opened, 0) AS schools_opened
  FROM all_months am
  LEFT JOIN monthly_openings mo ON am.year_month = mo.year_month
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(schools_opened) AS FLOAT) / 12.0 AS average_schools_per_month
FROM monthly_counts_filled;

WITH TarmogoyfPrintings AS (
  SELECT c.setCode, c.frameVersion
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
),
FrameYearMapping AS (
  -- Map frameVersion (string) to its frame year as integer
  SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion, 
    CASE
      WHEN frameVersion = '1993' THEN 1993
      WHEN frameVersion = '1997' THEN 1997
      WHEN frameVersion = '2003' THEN 2003
      WHEN frameVersion = '2015' THEN 2015
      ELSE NULL
    END AS frameYear
  FROM cards
  WHERE frameVersion IS NOT NULL
),
TarmogoyfWithSetDates AS (
  SELECT t.setCode, t.frameVersion, f.frameYear, s.releaseDate,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', s.releaseDate) AS INTEGER) AS releaseYear
  FROM TarmogoyfPrintings t
  JOIN FrameYearMapping f ON t.frameVersion = f.frameVersion
  JOIN sets s ON s.code = t.setCode
  WHERE f.frameYear IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate
FROM TarmogoyfWithSetDates t
JOIN sets s ON s.code = t.setCode
WHERE (t.releaseYear - t.frameYear) >= 10
ORDER BY s.releaseDate;

  SELECT

  JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON ta.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id AND ta.date <= m.date
  GROUP BY ta.team_api_id, m.id, m.date
),

  SELECT
    ta.team_api_id,
    l.match_id,
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass

  SELECT

    AND b.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'

),

)

ORDER BY h.big_fast_wins DESC, t.team_long_name;

  FROM loan l
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = l.account_id AND dp.client_id = c.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
TopLoanThreshold AS (
  SELECT MIN(approved_amount) AS min_top_amount
  FROM (
    SELECT approved_amount
    FROM FemaleLoans
    GROUP BY approved_amount
    ORDER BY approved_amount DESC
    LIMIT 3
  )
),
TopFemaleLoans AS (
  SELECT * FROM FemaleLoans
  WHERE approved_amount >= (SELECT min_top_amount FROM TopLoanThreshold)
),
LoanPayments AS (
  SELECT
    loan_id,
    ROUND(monthly_payment * duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(monthly_payment * duration - approved_amount, 2) AS interest_paid
  FROM TopFemaleLoans
),
AccountTransStats AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_deposits
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
IncomeCat AS (
  SELECT
    tfl.loan_id,
    CASE
      WHEN ats.total_deposits > 2 * tfl.approved_amount THEN 'High Income'
      WHEN ats.total_deposits > tfl.approved_amount THEN 'Medium Income'
      ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category
  FROM TopFemaleLoans tfl
  LEFT JOIN AccountTransStats ats ON ats.account_id = tfl.account_id
),
RegionLoanCount AS (
  SELECT
    d.A7 AS region,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loans_in_region
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A7
),
RegionAvgSalary AS (
  SELECT
    A7 AS region,
    ROUND(AVG(A13), 2) AS avg_salary
  FROM district
  GROUP BY A7
),
ClientsAge AS (
  SELECT
    client_id,
    birth_date,
    (strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) -
    CASE
      WHEN strftime('%m%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m%d', birth_date) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS age_completed_2026_10_09
  FROM client
),
BranchDistrictRegion AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id AS branch_district_id,
    d.A7 AS region
  FROM account a
  LEFT JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
),
FinalResult AS (
  SELECT
    tfl.client_id,
    tfl.approved_amount AS loan_amount,
    tfl.duration,
    lp.total_payments,
    lp.interest_paid,
    tfl.status AS loan_status,
    bd.branch_district_id AS branch_district,
    bd.region,
    COALESCE(ats.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
    COALESCE(ats.total_deposits, 0) AS total_deposits,
    ic.income_category,
    rlc.loans_in_region,
    ras.avg_salary AS region_avg_salary,
    ca.age_completed_2026_10_09 AS client_age_on_2026_10_09
  FROM TopFemaleLoans tfl
  JOIN LoanPayments lp ON lp.loan_id = tfl.loan_id
  JOIN BranchDistrictRegion bd ON bd.account_id = tfl.account_id
  LEFT JOIN AccountTransStats ats ON ats.account_id = tfl.account_id
  LEFT JOIN IncomeCat ic ON ic.loan_id = tfl.loan_id
  LEFT JOIN RegionLoanCount rlc ON rlc.region = bd.region
  LEFT JOIN RegionAvgSalary ras ON ras.region = bd.region
  JOIN ClientsAge ca ON ca.client_id = tfl.client_id
)
SELECT 
  client_id,
  ROUND(loan_amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
  duration,
  total_payments,
  interest_paid,
  loan_status,
  branch_district,
  region,
  trans_count,
  ROUND(total_deposits, 2) AS total_deposits,
  income_category,
  loans_in_region,
  region_avg_salary,
  client_age_on_2026_10_09
FROM FinalResult
ORDER BY loan_amount DESC, client_id
;

WITH BondGroups AS (
  SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
MoleculeGroups AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id AS molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
      WHEN bg.total_bonds = bg.single_bond_count THEN 'all_single_bonds'
      ELSE 'other_bonds'
    END AS group_type
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN BondGroups bg ON m.molecule_id = bg.molecule_id
),
Counts AS (
  SELECT
    group_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
  FROM MoleculeGroups
  GROUP BY group_type
)
SELECT
  group_type,
  carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count AS difference
FROM Counts;

),

  FROM atom

),
carcinogenic_molecules AS (

),
unique_elements AS (

  FROM atom a
  JOIN element_counts ec ON a.element = ec.element
  JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON a.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
  WHERE ec.molecule_count = 1
),

bond_atoms AS (

  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  UNION
  SELECT c.bond_id, a.element

),
bonds_with_unique_elements AS (

)

WITH non_carc_mols AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '-'
),
valid_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN non_carc_mols ncm ON b.molecule_id = ncm.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
),
bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, a.element
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE c.bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM valid_bonds)
),
c_bonds AS (
  SELECT ba1.bond_id, ba1.element AS element1, ba2.element AS element2
  FROM bond_atoms ba1
  JOIN bond_atoms ba2 ON ba1.bond_id = ba2.bond_id AND ba1.element <> ba2.element
  WHERE ba1.element = 'C' OR ba2.element = 'C'
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN element1 = 'C' THEN element2 ELSE element1 END AS element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS count
FROM c_bonds
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

WITH BondAtomPairs AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_symbol,
    b.molecule_id AS molecule_id,
    CASE
      WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element
      ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element
    END AS element_pair
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = substr(b.bond_id, 1, instr(b.bond_id, '-')-1) AND a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = substr(b.bond_id, instr(b.bond_id, '-')+1) AND a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377' AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
), BondSummary AS (
  SELECT
    bond_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT element_pair) AS element_pair_count
  FROM BondAtomPairs
  GROUP BY bond_symbol
), MoleculeLabel AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, label AS carcinogenicity_label
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
)

SELECT
  bs.bond_symbol,
  bs.bond_count,
  bs.element_pair_count,
  ml.carcinogenicity_label
FROM BondSummary bs
CROSS JOIN MoleculeLabel ml
ORDER BY bs.bond_count DESC, bs.bond_symbol ASC;

WITH metal_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE LOWER(element) IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
),
metal_bonded_molecules AS (

  FROM atom

non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '-'
),
molecules_with_single_bonds AS (
  SELECT molecule_id FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN bond_type != '-' THEN 1 END) = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN metal_bonded_molecules mbm ON m.molecule_id = mbm.molecule_id
JOIN non_carcinogenic_molecules ncm ON m.molecule_id = ncm.molecule_id
JOIN molecules_with_single_bonds msb ON m.molecule_id = msb.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

WITH atom_bonds AS (
    SELECT c.atom_id, b.bond_type
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
), single_bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT ab.atom_id
    FROM atom_bonds ab
    GROUP BY ab.atom_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ab.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*)
       AND COUNT(*) > 0
)
SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN single_bond_atoms sba ON a.atom_id = sba.atom_id
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element ASC;
